method: Alard & Lupton (1998) kernel expanded on three Gaussians with polynomial modulation, fitted by linear least squares on bright isolated stars. Both convolution directions are tried and the smaller residual is kept.
notAttempted: The kernel is constant across the frame. Spatial variation is the next refinement, and the residual measured here is what shows whether it is needed.
measuredAgainst: Median peak absolute difference at star positions, in units of the frame's own difference scatter, before and after. A region is only counted as improved if that number falls.
